api.notes: The trigger: a button, a role=button element, or a library element rendering one.
Also the `anchor` attribute (id of an element in the same tree). The referenced element must be, or contain, a button.
Optional-controlled upstream; here the element owns the state and `open` is the current value (D-006).
Cancelable intent event before user-driven changes; `tct-after-open-change` once a change settled (every actual change, including programmatic ones, like the upstream callback).
A bare number is px; anything else is a CSS length. Applied through a private custom property.
Renamed: a public `role` attribute would shadow the global one (A§7.1).

api.reason: A-xstyle: use class/style, ::part(popover) and the tokens.
A-xstyle: attributes go on the host element.
A-xstyle: `class` goes on the host; the painted surface is ::part(popover).
A-xstyle: `style` goes on the host; the painted surface is ::part(popover).

hooks.notes: Other families that need a dialog-style popover (date pickers, comboboxes) compose the same three controllers or embed tct-popover.

keyboard.action: Opens or closes the popover from the trigger
Closes the popover and returns focus to the trigger
keyboard.when: open; not `no-escape-dismiss`; one layer per press

keyboard.action: Moves to the next control; after the last control the close button is revealed, then focus wraps to the first control
Moves to the previous control; before the first control focus wraps to the close button

differences.text: Boolean defaults that were true upstream are inverted (`no-close-button`, `no-auto-focus`, `no-light-dismiss`, `no-escape-dismiss`, `non-modal`), `isEnabled` is `disabled`, `role` is `popup-role` and `closeButtonLabel` is `close-label` (A§7.1, A§7.2).
The React render-prop trigger mode is not needed: the default slot holds the trigger, and `anchor` / `anchorElement` replace `anchorRef` for a trigger that lives elsewhere.
The surface lives in the popover's shadow root, so the trigger carries no `aria-controls`: ID relationships never cross a shadow boundary (A§8.2). aria-haspopup and aria-expanded are unchanged.

`no-escape-dismiss` takes full effect on its own. Upstream needs `hasLightDismiss=false` too, because native popover=auto light dismiss also closes on Escape; the surface here is always popover=manual and dismissal belongs to the layer stack. A popover that ignores Escape lets it fall through to the layer below.
Tecton surface: a 1px border on the recessed popover fill, no drop shadow, 8px container radius (D-013, design/components/menu.md, theme components.ts `popover`).

core.popover.notes: Guides: [mwg:declarative-dialog-popover-control] [mwg:animate-to-from-top-layer] [mwg:position-aware-tooltips] [mwg:persistent-top-layer-ui] [mwg:platform-controls-dismiss-dialog]. The fallback close button is a tct-button (secondary); the UA popover reset is the shared .layer-surface.
